title: Venus mahadasha: 20 years of love, comfort and growth | Ask Tota
description: Venus mahadasha is the longest dasha at 20 years. Its nine antardashas, why it shines for Capricorn and Aquarius ascendants, and what decides yours.
og_description: Twenty years of Shukra. Love, comfort, art and money themes, the nine sub-periods, and why a strong Venus period is not automatically an easy one.
h1: venus mahadasha is the longest chapter in the dasha cycle. here is how to read urs
dek: twenty years, the longest of the nine periods, ruled by the planet of love, beauty, comfort and pleasure. it has the friendliest reputation of any dasha, and it is still entirely personal: venus's houses, strength and company in ur chart decide what those twenty years hold.
card_title: venus mahadasha is the longest chapter in the dasha cycle. here is how to read urs
card_dek: twenty years of shukra: love, comfort, art and money themes, nine sub-periods, and why a venus period is personal, not automatically easy.
llms_desc: Venus (Shukra) mahadasha in Vimshottari: 20 years, the nine antardashas and their lengths, why Venus is yogakaraka for Capricorn and Aquarius ascendants, factors that decide results, common themes (relationships, comfort, creativity, finances), remedies and myths.

faq.a: 20 years, the longest of all nine mahadashas. it comes after ketu's 7 years and before the sun's 6.

venus is a natural benefic, so its period has a friendly reputation. whether urs is good depends on what venus rules from ur ascendant, its sign and house, and its associations. for capricorn and aquarius ascendants it is the yogakaraka, the most beneficial planet.

faq.q: what are the effects of venus mahadasha?
faq.a: commonly reported themes are relationships and marriage, comfort and luxury, art, music, fashion and beauty, vehicles and property, and growth in finances. where venus sits in ur houses decides which themes come forward.
venus is the natural significator of marriage and partnership, so its period often features relationship themes. actual timing depends on ur 7th house, its lord and transits as well.

faq.q: what is the first antardasha in venus mahadasha?
faq.a: venus-venus, exactly 3 years 4 months, the longest antardasha in the whole system. then sun, moon, mars, rahu, jupiter, saturn, mercury and ketu.

faq.q: which antardasha is best in venus mahadasha?
faq.a: saturn and mercury are venus's natural friends, so venus-saturn and venus-mercury are often read as smoother. venus-saturn is especially valued for capricorn, aquarius, taurus and libra ascendants.

faq.q: is venus mahadasha good for career?
faq.a: it often favours careers in arts, design, fashion, hospitality, beauty, entertainment, luxury goods and anything involving relationships with people. venus's house placement refines this.

faq.q: what does an exalted venus in mahadasha mean?
faq.a: venus is exalted in pisces. an exalted, well placed venus is traditionally read as giving refinement, comfort and harmonious relationships during its period.

faq.q: what does a debilitated venus in mahadasha mean?
faq.a: venus is debilitated in virgo. relationships and pleasures may need more care, unless neecha bhanga applies. check the cancellation rules before drawing conclusions.

yes. a venus ruling the 6th, 8th or 12th, or afflicted by malefics, can bring venusian themes through harder routes: overindulgence, relationship tangles or spending. benefic does not mean effortless.

faq.q: what are the remedies for venus mahadasha?
faq.a: traditional observances include friday fasting, venus mantras, lakshmi worship, donating white items such as rice or sugar, and respecting women. diamond or white sapphire is the traditional stone, only after chart review.
sun mahadasha, 6 years. the change from venus's twenty years of relationship and comfort themes to the sun's shorter, more self-directed period is often noticeable.
